notes.title: Release Date and AI Pals Engine
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Holidays![/b]

Based on the feedback I shift the focus of AI Pals to something less complicated and to a more traditional AI assistant application (in a new software categorized project). It will be the priority in [b]2025 with a release soon[/b].
The new project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3410930/AI_Pals_Engine]AI Pals Engine[/url] is similar to AI Pals, but with less focus on game elements, but still with a focus on the Workshop, customizable Widgets and more!

Please be sure to check out and consider to [b]Wishlist and Follow[/b] the new project as the release is coming soon. The AI Pals release date will remain [b]TBD[/b] until AI Pals Engine is fully released.
Here's the link:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3410930/AI_Pals_Engine]AI Pals Engine[/url]

[b]Thank You![/b]
